papers.title: ACEdit: Stable Multi-Turn Image Editing via Asymmetric Conditioning
papers.abstract: Proposes self-forcing training with teacher distillation and asymmetric conditioning, so multi-turn image editors stay stable and resist quality decay across successive edits.

papers.title: StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early
papers.abstract: A small fine-tuned external monitor predicts coding-agent failures from recent tool steps and aborts doomed runs early, lowering cost per successful solve on SWE-bench.

papers.title: Progress-Aware Distillation for Mitigating Stagnation in Small Language Model Agents
papers.abstract: Detects and penalizes stagnation in distilled small language model agents, which get stuck in unproductive loops, improving their success rates and task-completion efficiency.

papers.title: N-Gram Memories at Two Bits: Quantizing Lookup Tables in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Compresses n-gram embedding tables by rebuilding only requested rows from short codes and a shared program, cutting DeepSeek's table storage from 203GB to 51GB.

papers.title: Predicting Privileged Information Effectiveness for On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: Shows that privileged information content and source shape on-policy self-distillation for multi-turn LLM agents, and that KL-based metrics predict training gains better than utility.

papers.title: Heterogeneous Agentic Coevolution
papers.abstract: Jointly evolves specialized foundation models and LLM agents through reciprocal learning, tuning their interaction harness with evolutionary search across recommendation, protein, and materials tasks.

papers.title: HERA: Harness-Environment Co-Evolution for Reliable Agentic Abstention
papers.abstract: Co-evolves agent harnesses and task environments by mutating solvable tasks into infeasible ones, improving abstention and feasible-task completion for tool-using LLM agents.

papers.title: Training Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas
papers.abstract: Uses a set-level RL objective so an 8B model steers each generated research idea away from earlier ones, raising diversity while keeping quality and executability.

papers.title: CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat
papers.abstract: A dynamic benchmark where two AI agents attack and defend concurrently in isolated sandboxes, scoring 12 frontier LLM agents across 466 matches.

papers.title: Beyond Maliciousness: Static and Runtime Attack-Surface Profiling of Agent Skills
papers.abstract: Profiles 6,309 agent skill listings with static analysis and sandbox runs, finding that most gain shell or file access and that declared permissions often understate actual reach.

cc_updates.body:
## What's changed

* Added `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections
* Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset
* Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways that add latency to every tool-search call
* Fixed agents losing their context window when a model is unavailable and the session falls back to a different one mid-conversation

## What's changed

* Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin
* Added `decider: "person"` to a mod's `tool.check` answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked
* Added `e.isReadOnly` to a mod's `tool.check` event, set when the tool call is read-only
* Added `/auto-mode-setup`: a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your workflow

## What's changed

* Bug fixes and reliability improvements
